entities.name: French Settlement and Sugar Plantations
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: French settlers gradually encroached on Saint Vincent from neighboring Martinique, establishing sugar plantations in the Leeward valleys while the Windward side remained under Carib control. The Treaty of Paris (1763) ceded Saint Vincent to Britain.
